network.tdh.rules.title: Current boosts
network.tdh.rules.intro: Today’s boost values and the full schedule, from 6529.io’s current rule, boost schedule 1.4.
network.tdh.rules.error: Current rules are temporarily unavailable. Try again to load the snapshot and boost schedule.
network.tdh.rules.snapshotNote: The values use today’s definitions with that snapshot’s eligible cards.
network.tdh.rules.full.title: A full Meme collection
network.tdh.rules.full.body: Hold at least one of every eligible Meme card—{count} token IDs in this snapshot, including the current season’s eligible cards. The first full collection earns +{bonus}, the sum of eligible season bonuses.
network.tdh.rules.full.extra: Each additional full collection adds +{initial} × {decay}ⁿ, where n is the number of earlier additional collections. These bonuses have no set-count cap, but their combined limit is +{limit}.
network.tdh.rules.partial.title: Without a full collection
network.tdh.rules.partial.body: Each eligible season you complete adds its bonus once. Multiple copies of a season set do not multiply that season’s bonus. These bonuses apply across all your eligible holdings.
network.tdh.rules.noSeasons: No seasons qualify for a season-set bonus in this snapshot.
network.tdh.rules.partial.note: When Season 1 qualifies but your Season 1 set is incomplete, the Genesis and Nakamoto bonuses can apply together. A complete Season 1 set replaces both partial bonuses. Full-collection bonuses replace the individual season and partial-set bonuses.
network.tdh.rules.gradient.title: Add Gradients
network.tdh.rules.gradient.body: Add +{bonus} for each distinct Gradient, up to {count}. The maximum Gradient bonus is +{maximum}. Add this to the baseline and Meme bonus, then round the multiplier to {decimals} decimal places.
network.tdh.rules.future.body: Seasons 1–{lastSeason} each have a +{bonus} season bonus. Later seasons add no new season bonus. A season starts contributing only after a later season enters the snapshot’s eligible card range.
network.tdh.rules.future.full: Once all {count} season bonuses qualify, the first full collection gives {multiplier}× before Gradients.
network.tdh.rules.future.condition: The schedule’s highest combines all scheduled season bonuses, enough additional full collections and {gradients} Gradients. The additional-collection series has a mathematical limit; rounding lets the final multiplier reach this value with a finite number of sets.
network.tdh.rules.future.cards: Future cards still matter: complete collections must include every eligible Meme card, even in seasons that add no new season bonus. Ownership, holding time and edition-rate inputs continue to change; the boost schedule determines how those inputs are treated.
network.tdh.rules.full.short: One of each of the {count} eligible Memes, before Gradients
network.tdh.rules.partial.short: Each complete eligible season adds its bonus once, to everything you hold.
network.tdh.rules.details: How the bonuses combine, and where the schedule ends
network.tdh.rules.ladder.title: Four boost figures, and how they relate
network.tdh.rules.ladder.intro: Every boost starts at 1.00×. These are the figures quoted across these pages, on one scale.
network.tdh.rules.ladder.fullSetToday: A full set today: one of each of the {count} eligible Memes
network.tdh.rules.ladder.fullSetAllSeaso: A full set once seasons 1–{last} all pay
network.tdh.rules.ladder.highestToday: Today’s highest: a full set, extra full sets and {gradients} Gradients
network.tdh.rules.ladder.highestEver: The schedule’s highest: the same, once seasons 1–{last} all pay
network.tdh.rules.ladder.note: Blue bars are reachable today; grey bars once later seasons are eligible. A season pays once a later season has begun, so the current season never does.
